description: Opens any ihumane module before that part of the work: its workflow, its first step and the rules likely to matter for your task. ihumane_start tells you which modules apply. Modules: ihumane core: 'humans' (Working with your human). Design: 'ui-design' (UI design), 'ux-design' (UX design), 'graphics' (Graphics and images). Engineering: 'code-craft' (Code craft), 'front-end' (Front-end build), 'code-review' (Code review), 'qa-testing' (QA and testing). Product: 'product-thinking' (Product thinking). Writing: 'copy' (Copy and UX writing). Free: each module's start; the other rules are ihumane Pro and are named by title.

task.description: What you're about to do, in a sentence, e.g. 'test the new checkout before release'
